scope: remaining loss classes: revision/compat metadata, table/char controls with WML slots, comments, revisions, textboxes, OLE, document metadata
implemented: revision save identifiers and the Word 6/7 + Asian layout controls whose bare value is the Strict default are named Info instead of Loss: `\insrsid`/`\charrsid`/`\pararsid` (`rsid-compat`), `\faauto`/`\adjustright`/`\aspalpha`/`\aspnum` (`word6-compat`), and `\hyphpar`/`\wrapdefault`/`\sectdefaultcl`/`\linex`/`\lnbrkrule`/`\partightenfactor` (`paragraph-compat`). Corpus import losses 83010 -> 11394.

character controls with a real WML slot are mapped instead of dropped: `\kerning` -> `w:kern` (the WPS spelling of `\kern`), `\ulc` -> `w:u/@w:color`, and `\cb` -> `w:rPr/w:shd` (the WPS spelling of the character background, the same property as `\chcbpat`).

text highlight `\highlightN` -> `w:highlight`: the parameter indexes the colour table and the colour is matched to the `ST_HighlightColor` name (index 0 clears the highlight); a colour outside the fixed highlight set stays a Loss.

table controls with a real WML slot are mapped: `\trpadd{t,b,l,r}`/`\trpaddf{t,b,l,r}` -> `w:tblCellMar` (with `\trgaph` as the fallback), `\trrh` -> `w:trHeight` (negative value = `exact`), `\trqr`/`\trql`/`\trqc` -> `w:trPr/w:jc`, and `\trautofit` -> `w:tblLayout`.
`\pardeftab`/`\deftab` -> `w:defaultTabStop` in settings.xml, and a nested `{\*\panose ...}` -> `w:panose1` on the font-table entry.

the non-visual metadata destinations are named Info: `{\*\falt}`, `{\*\hyphen}`, `{\*\pnseclvl}`, `{\*\rsidtbl}`, `{\*\revtbl}`, `{\*\latentstyles}`, `{\*\expandedcolortbl}`, `{\*\xmlnstbl}`, `{\*\pgptbl}`, `{\*\pgdsctbl}`, `{\*\wgrffmtfilter}`, `{\*\userprops}`, `{\*\fname}` and `{\*\generator}`.

document settings and metadata control families are named Info: the table/section/style revision ids (`\styrsid`/`\tblrsid`/`\sectrsid`/`\rsidroot`), view settings, Word-for-Mac Cocoa flags, drawing-grid display settings, math layout settings (`w:mathPr`), Word application settings, `\widowctrl` (the Strict default), `\additive`, `\pardirnatural`, and the Word 6/7 default-language hints (`\deflang`/`\deflangfe`/`\adeflang`).

the WPS-default controls whose reference writes nothing back are named Info: `\hyphpar0`/`
oline` (`paragraph-compat`), `
ooverflow`/`
ocwrap` (`table-cell-compat`), `\cltxlrtb` (the default cell direction), `\hres`/`\chhres` (`picture-resolution`), `\qk`/`\qnatural` (`paragraph-compat`), `\animtext` (`character-compat`) and the row-width unit/value hints (`table-row-compat`).
the WPS profile's leading group whitespace drop (`wps:header-whitespace:dropped`) is a named Info: WPS drops the same whitespace, so matching it is not a loss.

picture crop `\piccrop{t,b,l,r}` maps to DrawingML `a:srcRect`: the twips inset becomes thousandths of a percent of the displayed extent, and an all-zero crop writes no `a:srcRect` (witness 075 has the only non-zero crops).
`{\*\picprop ...}` Word 97 shape hints are a named Info: the WPS reference writes no picture properties back and the Strict picture has no non-visual slot.

table styles (`{\*\tsN ...}` and `\tsN`/`\tsdN`) are a named Info (`destination:ts`, `table-style-compat:ts`/`:tsd`): every independent WPS reference writes a single built-in "Normal Table" style and reproduces the effective table properties directly from the rows the producer repeats.

legacy numbering and non-visual metadata destinations are named Info: `{\*\pn ...}` (superseded by the list table), `\defchp`/`\defpap` (superseded by `w:docDefaults`), `\template`, `\datastore`, `\blipuid`, `\updnprop`, `\mmathPr`, and `\themedata`/`\colorschememapping` (unreferenced because RTF resolves theme colours to the explicit colour table).

the WPS leading-group line ending (`wps:leading-group-line-ending`) is a named Info, not a Loss: the WPS profile preserves the line feed exactly as WPS does (the reference writes the same `
`), and the decoded body text matches the oracle for every affected document (005/058/059/075). This corrects the earlier conservative classification.

Word 97 shapes (`{\shp ...}`) map to a `wp:anchor` instead of being dropped: `\shpinst` geometry becomes `wp:positionH/V`/`wp:wrap*`/`relativeHeight`/`behindDoc`; `{\sp{\sn X}{\sv Y}}` properties select the preset geometry, solid fill (`fillType`/`fillColor`), outline (`fLine`/`lineWidth`/`lineColor`) and the non-visual name/description; `\shptxt` becomes `wps:txbx/w:txbxContent` (fields included); a nested `{\pict}` (`pib`/`fillBlip`/`\shppict`) becomes the anchored `pic:pic` and keeps its media. Shape layout hints with no slot (`\posx`/`\posy`, `\pvpara`, `\wraparound`, `\dfrmtxt*`, `\dxfrtext`, `\absnoovrlp`, `\anchorText`, `\shprslt`) and the blip ids (`\bliptag`/`\blipupi`) are named Info.
remaining: grouped shapes (`\shpgrp`), OLE objects (`\object`/`\objdata`), comments (`\annotation`), tracked revisions and textboxes outside a shape are still Loss; they need per-class mapping tasks. The independent WPS reference writes shapes as transitional `w:pict`/`v:shape` VML, which Strict forbids, so DrawingML is required (floating `\shp` shapes are now mapped).

the implicit `\s0` (a stylesheet whose first entry omits `\s0`) is deliberately NOT materialized as a `w:default` Normal style: WPS does not do so, and doing it reflowed 004/017/018/021/051/087 (pagination 66 -> 63, 004 117 -> 156 pages). The `style:undefined-parent:rtf-s0` and `stylesheet:unbound-text` losses therefore stay.

the language sentinels `\lang0`/`\lang1024` and other unknown LCIDs stay explicit `language:unknown-lcid` Loss (pinned by `unknown_language_lcid_remains_an_explicit_loss`/`unknown_alang_lcid_remains_an_explicit_loss`).

lower-confidence application/layout flags are deliberately left as Loss rather than blanket-renamed to Info: `\newtblstyruls`, `\notbrkcnstfrctbl`, `\indrlsweleven`, `\sectlinegrid`, `\horzdoc`, `\stshf*`, `\clmar*`, `\gaph`, `\fet`, and the character stroke controls.

assertions: each mapping round-trips through the writer and reader (document + reopened)
every classified control produces loss_count 0 with its named Info feature
picture crop round-trips to a:srcRect through the writer and reader; zero crop writes none
the WPS leading-group line feed matches the independent oracle text and is Info
a \shp maps to a wp:anchor with the shape extent and a wps:wsp/wps:txbx or pic:pic graphic
a shape picture keeps its media part and every processed shape document passes `check` -> ok: strict

results.output_identity: the shape mapping changes only the five shape documents (003/017/075/078/092); the earlier severity-only slices are SHA-256 identical
